Keep the documents at the top level

Open the side menu to switch between all documents, your favorites, and named folders. Tap the star icon on a document card to mark or unmark it as a favorite. Select one or more documents and tap the Folder button to move them. Long-press a folder in the menu to rename or delete it — documents move to the top level when a folder is deleted.

Documents can be organised into folders and marked as favorites. The side menu lists all folders and a Favorites filter. Folders are flat (no nesting); deleting a folder moves its documents back to the top level.
